summary: Adial Pharmaceuticals filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing a further adjournment of its 2026 Annual Meeting solely as to Proposals 3, 4, 5 and 6, because Nasdaq conditional approval of its Initial Listing Application remains outstanding. The September 17, 2026 meeting was previously partially adjourned to October 1, 2026; on that date the company again adjourned those four proposals, with polls remaining open, to October 15, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET in Charlottesville, Virginia. The record date remains August 17, 2026. This is a routine meeting-procedure update, not a special situation.
